headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers, who won 8-0 behind a strong pitching performance from Keider Montero. The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 5-4.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. Daniel Susac, the San Francisco Giants' catcher, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain. Phil Maton, a right-handed pitcher for the Chicago Cubs, has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis. Marcelo Mayer, a second baseman for the Boston Red Sox, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a bone stress reaction to the left ulna.

The Chicago Cubs have made a significant roster move, acquiring left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. The San Francisco Giants have also placed catcher Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Dominant 8-0 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers, who won 8-0 behind a strong pitching performance. Keider Montero led the way for the Tigers, throwing 7.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. Marte's 4th home run of the season, a line drive to left center field, scored Sal Stewart and proved crucial in the Reds' win.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Blaze Alexander led the Nationals' offense with 1 hit, 2 RBI, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 5-4. Justin Foscue led the Rangers' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Catcher on Injured List**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants have placed catcher Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded to the team.
